name: New America Construction & Services Inc
address: 1971 W McNab Rd #2, Pompano Beach, FL 33069, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ben Reyes
reviewSamples.text:
I first became familiar with New America Construction when they were awarded the contract to replace the roof at the building where I work. I was impressed by how well the job was executed — the crew worked efficiently, maintained a clean site, and completed the project quickly. Based on that experience, I kept their contact information knowing my own home would eventually need a new roof.

A few years later, with no issues whatsoever from the office building roof, I decided to call them for my house. The quoting process was straightforward, and their pricing was competitive compared to other estimates I received. From start to finish, the project ran smoothly. Communication was consistent, and I appreciated being able to follow the progress through daily photos uploaded by the site manager.

Overall, New America Construction delivered exactly what they promised: quality workmanship, transparency, and a well-managed project. I would not hesitate to recommend them for both commercial and residential roofing work.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Aaron Nevins
reviewSamples.text:
They were professional, dependable and incredibly thorough. The quality of the work was excellent. They paid close attention to the small details that made the finished roof look great.  They saved our state safe Florida home grant. It’s rare to find a contractor who takes this much pride in the job and follows through on every promise.

After another roofer left our home unfinished and exposed for 50+ days, this company stepped in and bailed us out. We needed a full facia and soffit. Once work began, they completed the entire roof in just four (4!) days.

I highly recommend them.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Elise Dillard
reviewSamples.text:
I Absolutely love My brand new metal roof!!! After doing my homework thoroughly, obtaining various estimates from a few different companies, I met with Andy Ortiz, from New America Construction. Mr. Ortiz broke it down to me like no other company did. He explained the different metal materials, the length of time it would take, the process, the cost involved, and answered any and all questions that I had. Moreover, Mr. Ortiz followed up with me routinely throughout the entire process.

The crew involved in replacing my roof were efficient, thorough, and precise. They made sure to protect the areas surrounding my home to ensure that nothing was damaged. And I must say, they left my yard and surrounding areas cleaner than they were prior to their arrival. To say that I was impressed is an understatement! I couldn’t be happier with the job that they did!

I recommend them to all of my law-enforcement family, and friends! Their commitment to providing quality work with honesty and integrity has made me a BELIEVER!

Check out my new Metal roof!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Nancy Gonzalez
reviewSamples.text:
I had an amazing experience with New America Construction and Services Inc. From the very beginning, Andy was incredibly knowledgeable. He inspected my roof thoroughly and explained exactly what was needed to bring everything up to code and ensure proper maintenance. His honesty and expertise immediately put me at ease.

I also want to give a huge shout‑out to Elvin, the project manager, who was outstanding throughout the entire process. He was organized, attentive, and made sure every detail was handled perfectly. His communication and professionalism made the whole project smooth and stress‑free.

The entire crew was just as impressive, neat, respectful, and extremely clean. They worked efficiently and left my property spotless.

Not only did they take care of my roofing needs, but they also brought a personal vision of mine to life. I shared an idea for a small garden in front of my home, and they transformed the space instantly with beautiful decorative rocks. The curb appeal upgrade was beyond what I imagined.

If you’re looking for a top‑tier roofing and home services company, look no further. Andy, Elvin, and the entire team truly go above and beyond. I highly recommend New America Construction and Services Inc. for quality, integrity, and exceptional results. Thank you guys!!! :)
